**1h**

### 2026-10-23 – I started this session by taking a look at the PCB looking at how things are.. i did some minor adjustments like moving silkscreen , components and noting where the potentiometers should be on the CAD

**2h**

I started this session by taking a look at the PCB looking at how things are.. i did some minor adjustments like moving silkscreen , components and noting where the potentiometers should be on the CAD so when ill place them ill have no surprises. also i started modlling the enclosure for the pedal and for now it's going well.. i did some small holes on the back too so the wires can go out to the battery but also i still need to add the input jack.
